review_improvement: Prevents identical adjacent source content from being counted twice without a purpose distinction and avoids inventing raw IPMI bytes when the source already specifies standard read-only collection.
independent_technical_reasoning: Dual-rotor chassis fans expose separate front and rear tachometers, and a broad fan filter does not prove bank, FRU or rotor side.
